premise: In the morning fog Fox can't find Raccoon, until Raccoon peeks out from behind his paws right under Fox's nose and says BOO.
inspiration: The hide-and-seek of folk games and Blind Man's Buff, gentled: the fog hides, but the finding happens nose to nose and ends in laughing.
lesson: The best surprises end with everyone laughing.

en-US.title: Raccoon Hides in the Fog
en-US.text: {canvas:fog 0.7 32s} [whispers] One morning, a soft white fog rolled into the forest. Everything went fuzzy and quiet. {raccoon:face happy} [excited] Perfect for hide-and-seek! said Raccoon {raccoon:hop}. Fox {fox:pulse} covered his eyes. One, two, three… ten! Ready or not! He looked behind the bushes. Only fog. {fox:face sad} He looked by the stream. Only fog. Badger {badger:wobble} shuffled past. [curious] Have you seen Raccoon? {badger:shake 0.4} Badger shook his head. It's too foggy to see anything! Then, very close by, something rustled. {sfx:rustle solo} Fox turned round, and round again. [slowly] And right in front of his nose, out of the fog… {raccoon:live} Raccoon rubbed his paws, covered his eyes, peeked… {fox:face surprised} [surprised] and BOO! Fox {fox:spin} jumped so high he spun. {fox:face happy} [laughs] Found you! said Fox. No, said Raccoon, I found YOU! {fox:hearts}

es-ES.title: Mapache se esconde en la niebla
es-ES.text: {canvas:fog 0.7 32s} [whispers] Una mañana, una niebla blanca y suave entró en el bosque. Todo se volvió borroso y callado. {raccoon:face happy} [excited] ¡Perfecto para jugar al escondite!, dijo Mapache {raccoon:hop}. Zorro {fox:pulse} se tapó los ojos. Uno, dos, tres… ¡diez! ¡Allá voy! Buscó detrás de los arbustos. Solo niebla. {fox:face sad} Buscó junto al arroyo. Solo niebla. Tejón {badger:wobble} pasó arrastrando las patas. [curious] ¿Has visto a Mapache? {badger:shake 0.4} Tejón negó con la cabeza. ¡Con esta niebla no se ve nada! Entonces, muy cerquita, algo crujió. {sfx:rustle solo} Zorro se dio la vuelta, y otra vuelta más. [slowly] Y justo delante de su nariz, saliendo de la niebla… {raccoon:live} Mapache se frotó las patitas, se tapó los ojos, asomó… {fox:face surprised} [surprised] ¡y CUCÚ-TRAS! Zorro {fox:spin} dio un salto tan grande que dio una vuelta. {fox:face happy} [laughs] ¡Te encontré!, dijo Zorro. ¡No, dijo Mapache, yo te encontré a TI! {fox:hearts}

rustle.prompt: a small animal rustling gently in leafy bushes, soft and playful
